doctrine: Every record carries the full EvidenceLineageId preimage (frozen in replay-identity-schema-v1.json) BEFORE any model fitting. Independence groups gate corroboration: same-origin evidence counts ONCE; a record may never corroborate another record in its own group. calibration_or_holdout = not-yet-partitioned-no-fitting-allowed is a HARD FITTING BLOCK until E1.2/E4 consumers partition it.
attribution_correction: The plan's 'Deters/Selig 2004 prop reconstruction data' attribution is WRONG (verified 2026-08-17): AIAA 2004-0211 (Deters/Broughton/Selig) is a simulation-model retrospective built on the Ames tunnel data and contains no UIUC propeller tunnel tests. The actual propeller-reproduction tunnel campaign is Wright Experience/ODU at the Langley Full Scale Tunnel (records a2-props-bentend). Consumers citing 'Deters prop data' must repoint to a2-props-bentend.
